verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform. It could plausibly ship AI-generated insights over account or transaction data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents banking primitives: accounts, KYC, ACH, wires, cards and webhooks. It also shows an llms.txt docs index, which is AI-readable documentation rather than in-product AI insights. Nothing shows the product generating insights or suggestions from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
